# ligo_charter (Data Source)

The charter in force: the rules that every jurisdiction complies with.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ligo_charter" "now" {}

output "charter_sha256" {
  value = data.ligo_charter.now.sha256
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `policy` (String) The charter in force. As JSON text, in its normal form (sorted keys, no extra white space).
- `sha256` (String) The SHA-256 of the charter in force.
